target_review.notes: Compared the full original input, including the exercise and standing sl2 convention, with the selected target, spec and P. H001-H007 preserve respectively prime p, char K=p, 0<=lambda<p, the complex highest-weight representation and dimension, Chevalley generators/relations, the nonzero highest-weight vector/equations, and the arbitrary admissible lattice with a simultaneous integer/complex basis and U_Z stability. Parameter types introduce only ambient structures; these original conditions are all explicit H. D001-D003 and D013-D018 reproduce the original integral form and induced action. P retains nonzeroness and the universal invariant-subspace assertion for every field K, including lambda=0 and p=2. No minimal-lattice, algebraic-closure or distinct-reduced-weight assumption is added. N001-N004 and the five R edges preserve the supplied route: divided-power basis; localized matrix units; common coordinate module with proved rational rank one and a scalar generator; reduction/scalar extension; matrix-unit irreducibility. This target-fidelity assessment does not certify the R arguments.

D001.notes: Divided powers are defined in the complex enveloping algebra for every natural r; r! is nonzero in C, including 0!=1. The representation extends canonically to U(L), so the action notation adds no assumption.

D002.notes: The same characteristic-zero construction defines all Y_r, with the enveloping algebra and action supplied by D001. No preservation or integrality is granted.

D003.notes: The generated unital Z-subalgebra exists as the subalgebra generated by all X_r,Y_r in U(L); this reproduces the original integral form. Stability is separately H007.

D004.notes: n is simply the integer lambda+1. Its positivity and its interpretation as a dimension are not inserted by this definition.

D005.notes: The bounded integer interval is finite, including when empty before H003 is used. Its cardinality n and nonemptiness are exported in N001 rather than assumed.

D006.notes: Every natural-index e_i is defined by a nonzero complex factorial. Restriction to the nonnegative integer interval I is unambiguous; being a basis is reserved for N001.

D007.notes: H001 guards the subring construction: p is a nonzero prime, denominators exclude zero, and their products remain prime to p. The Q-to-C inclusion fixes all subsequent scalar actions; no map to K is assumed here.

D008.notes: R tensor_Z M is defined for the additive subgroup M and has its canonical R-module structure. Neither freeness nor embedding into V is assumed.

D009.notes: Multiplication R x M -> V is Z-balanced and R-linear in the required factor, so it defines the stated tensor map. Injectivity is separately exported by N002.

D010.notes: N001 is the explicit basis guard, giving existence and uniqueness of these complex linear operators. N001 does not depend on D010, and every R listing D010 has N001 directly. Preservation of the localized lattice is a separate N002 conclusion.

D011.notes: J_i is the inverse image of the R-submodule iota(M_R) under the R-linear map c -> c e_i, hence is an R-submodule. No nonzero, finite-generation, rank or equality assertion is hidden here.

D012.notes: e_0 exists independently of membership 0 in I, so the displayed inverse image defines J without a nonemptiness guard. The conditional identification with J_0 is definitional; equality of different coordinate modules remains N003.

D013.notes: M tensor_Z K with scalars acting on K is exactly the original V(K). Existence follows for any additive subgroup M; being nonzero is not assumed.

D014.notes: H005 supplies the integral Chevalley bracket on Zx+Zy+Zh; tensoring gives the stated Lie algebra. This preserves the original construction in characteristic 2 without imposing a distinct-weight or odd-characteristic condition.

D015.notes: The guards N002 and H005 supply lattice preservation and the restricted Chevalley relations. They justify the induced tensor action and representation, and are direct inputs of both R004 and R005. Irreducibility is not part of the definition.

D016.notes: This is the action of x tensor 1 on V_K, an endomorphism once D015 and its guards are available. No additional property of x_K is introduced.

D017.notes: This is the action of y tensor 1 on V_K, with the same guarded dependence on D015 and no extra hypothesis.

D018.notes: This is the action of h tensor 1 on V_K, with the same guarded dependence on D015. No eigenvalue distinctness is assumed.

D019.notes: N002 supplies X_r(M) subset M for every natural r, so the induced map on M tensor_Z K exists and is K-linear. This definition does not divide by r! in K; the inverse-factorial identity is restricted and proved in N004.

D020.notes: N002 supplies Y_r(M) subset M for every natural r, so tensoring defines all Y_r^K. No invertibility of arbitrary factorials in K is presumed.

D021.notes: H001 makes Z/pZ a field; H002 makes its integer-induced map to K a unital injection. Both guards are direct inputs wherever this definition is used. No algebraic closure of K is required.
